mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter indicates strong economic demand, which typically drives up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns over 60 days are negative in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% within the last month signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% within the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which typically leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity and consumer confidence improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month, the combined effect of strong job growth and a tightening labor market typically leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
regime_hint: tightening labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
